summary: Expose evidence-bound SSOT diagnostics through Wellman CLI

delivery.outcome: Expose deterministic SSOT findings and nonexecutable refactoring proposals through a bounded read-only CLI; test, independently merge and smoke-test an isolated installed wheel.
nonGoals: No source discovery, source edits, adoption, analyzer execution, or global runtime replacement
No changes to closed selection-plan schema or foreign worktrees

architecture.decision: Add an explicit ssot command reusing the existing bounded JSON reader and SSOT API. Input digests bind declarations to an observation; historical snapshot analysis does not prove current repository freshness.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of additive CLI adapter.

validation.evidence: Valid advisory output, deferred evidence, stale/invalid inputs and no input mutation.
Full tests, governance and independent exact-head merge.
Isolated wheel built from merged commit and installed CLI smoke.
